name: Bandera Pointe
summary: Bandera Pointe is a jumbo community shopping center in northwest San Antonio featuring big-box fashion and homewares discounters alongside casual dining options. Managed by Bridge33 Capital, this well-rated destination serves value-conscious shoppers with convenient access to everyday necessities and affordable merchandise.
demographics: Bandera Pointe serves the northwest San Antonio market, attracting middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers from the surrounding suburban communities. The trade area consists primarily of working families with household incomes in the $50,000-$75,000 range, including young professionals and established households seeking convenient access to big-box retailers and everyday necessities. Shoppers typically visit for routine shopping trips, combining errands across multiple discount retailers and casual dining options in a single visit, reflecting the practical, budget-minded preferences of the local market.
description: Bandera Pointe is a prominent community shopping center located at 11411 Bandera Road in San Antonio, Texas, strategically positioned to serve the growing northwest corridor of the city. Owned and managed by Bridge33 Capital, a commercial real estate investment firm known for their entrepreneurial approach and disciplined property management, this jumbo-sized center has established itself as a go-to destination for value-oriented shoppers. The center features an impressive collection of big-box fashion and homewares discounters, providing customers with a wide selection of affordable merchandise across multiple categories. Complementing the retail offerings, Bandera Pointe includes a variety of casual and fast-food eateries that cater to shoppers looking for convenient dining options during their visits. With a strong 4.4-star rating from over 4,150 reviews, the center has earned a reputation for delivering a practical, accessible shopping experience that meets the everyday needs of San Antonio's northwest community.
